title: Maldivian Supper Club, Food, Identity and Island Migration
episode_summary: James Staples and Luke Heslop explore Maldivian food and migration through a Maldivian Supper Club run by host Mie Ali Didi. The episode examines the distinctive position of the Maldives within South Asia, the small size of the Maldivian diaspora in the UK, and how food helps preserve cultural identity and connections to the islands. As there are no dedicated Maldivian restaurants in the UK, the supper club provides an important space for sharing Maldivian cuisine, memories and traditions.
